title: Country Tracker Configuration Schema
description: Schema for config/countries.json defining the list of trackable countries or territories.

name.description: Display name of the country or destination.

code.description: Unique 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code used as the primary identifier and for generating Unicode flag emojis.

ccn3.description: Optional 3-digit numeric ISO 3166-1 code (zero-padded, e.g., '004') used to match TopoJSON geometry IDs on the world map.

region.description: Optional geographic region used for filtering and badges.

capital.description: Optional capital city name used for display and search filtering.

flag.description: Optional custom emoji or symbol override if a non-standard flag should be displayed instead of the generated 2-letter regional indicator.
